Introduction

-ny day is a live idol unit-group based in South Korea. The group consists of 4 members: Nab2, Matsu, Tsubasa, and MOYA. The members were all revealed on June 11th, 2024. They made their debut at “-NY DAY FIRST LIVE” on June 24th, 2024.
